UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public-safe user profile summary for an authenticated workbench analyst.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the user.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the workbench account menu.

roleLabel.description: Optional analyst specialty or team label.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Isolated PII document storing the authenticated user's email address.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching the parent user document.

email.description: Verified email address of the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the private record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the private record was last updated.

SavedWorkspace.title: SavedWorkspace
SavedWorkspace.description: Saved Fellegi-Sunter model calibration thresholds and dataset metadata owned by a user.

presetId.description: Active dataset preset or source identifier.

priorMatch.description: Prior or EM-calibrated match prevalence pi_M.

matchCount.description: Count of final linked matches at save time.

clericalCount.description: Count of clerical pairs remaining at save time.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the snapshot was saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the snapshot was last modified.

/users/{userId}.description: Public-safe user profile documents keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Isolated PII subcollection storing private account info (docId = 'info').

/users/{userId}/workspaces/{workspaceId}.description: User-owned saved model threshold and linkage parameter snapshots.
